verdict.rationale: Synctera publishes an API reference: guides link to reference pages such as /v2/reference/createinternaltransfer, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is served at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json. Sandbox API keys let you start calling the APIs immediately. The evidence never shows that the reference is interactive or has in-browser runnable examples. Missing for 10: documented try-it/interactive console in the API reference, runnable code samples, hands-on or independent corroboration of interactivity.
